name: postgres-mcp-safe
stderr:
flag provided but not defined: -stdio
usage: postgres-mcp-safe [flags] <databaseUrl>
  -allow-explain-analyze
    	let the explain tool run EXPLAIN ANALYZE
  -allow-superuser
    	run as a superuser role (read-only is then not guaranteed)
  -max-bytes int
    	JSON bytes returned per call, and max size of one row (default 262144)
  -max-rows int
    	rows returned per call (default 1000)
  -timeout duration
    	time limit per call (default 30s)
